title: Mick's Irish Pub · Mid-City corner pub · New Orleans
description: Mid-City's Irish pub on Bienville: Guinness and Harp on tap, shuffleboard, pinball, and a kitchen. Open 11am to 2am, seven days.
name: Mick's Irish Pub

hero.kicker: Irish pub, shuffleboard & pinball · 4801 Bienville Ave, Mid-City
hero.headline: A Mid-City pub with Guinness on tap, a shuffleboard league on the wall, and Space Jam pinball in the back.
hero.sub: Open at eleven every morning and pouring until two, in a cream clapboard building under the oaks on Bienville. The taps run Irish and Louisiana both, and the bar games are the real draw.

paragraphs: Mick's is the pub on the Bienville corner in Mid-City, a cream clapboard building with green trim, a leprechaun swinging a shillelagh on the hanging sign, and string lights over the patio tables out front. Inside, the back bar carries a hand-lettered mick's irish pub board flanked by Jameson shamrocks, a Gnarly Barley surfboard from Hammond, and a small plaque that reads HELP WANTED, NO IRISH NEED APPLY. Somebody has been enjoying that joke for a long time.

The taps go Guinness, Harp and Smithwick's on the Irish side, then Abita, Gnarly Barley, Faubourg and Urban South on the Louisiana side, with coolers full of Schlitz, High Life ponies and Montucky behind the glass. The back room is the part regulars talk about: a full length shuffleboard table with New Orleans Shuffleboard League plaques stacked on the wall above it, a dartboard cabinet, a pool table, Space Jam and Simpsons pinball, and an Atari cabinet with the light gun still hanging on it. The kitchen sends out burgers and loaded fries while all that is going on.

facts: Open 11am to 2am, seven days a week
Great beer selection: Irish taps, Louisiana craft, and cheap cans
Bar games: shuffleboard, darts, pool, pinball and arcade cabinets
Kitchen serving food, and food at the bar, plus happy hour drinks
Patio tables out front, free street parking, cards and tap to pay

order.name: A Pint Off the Tap Wall
order.blurb: Guinness, Harp and Smithwick's on one side, Abita and Gnarly Barley on the other. Read the handles before you decide.

order.name: The Bacon Cheeseburger
order.blurb: Sesame bun, bacon laid across the top, cheese gone soft underneath. Order it at the bar and keep your stool.

order.name: Loaded Fries
order.blurb: Chili, cheese and a drizzle of ranch over a basket of fries. Built for sharing over a shuffleboard game.

order.name: A Cold One in the Dart Club Mug
order.blurb: The Orleans Dart Club mug comes out for the regulars. Ask about league night and you may get handed one.

items.name: Jameson, neat or in a shot

menu.note: Mick's does not post a menu online. This is what the tap handles, the coolers and the review photos show, so ask for the current list when you get there. Prices as posted and subject to change.

quote.text: “Great little pub with old school charm. They have all the good dive bar beers. I ordered a Schlitz and my guest grabbed Pony High Life.”

reviews.text: “A great local haunt full of laudable libations, and by that I mean good bartenders who will make whatever you want as long as they have the ingredients. This is not a cocktail bar, it's not a pisco kinda place, but they have the cure for …”

“Great little pub with old school charm. It was quiet in the late morning when I visited. However, you can just imagine this place on St Patty's day. They have all the good dive bar beers. I ordered a Schlitz and my guest grabbed Pony high …”

“Another neighborhood bar that I'm visiting for the 1st time. I only stopped in for a couple of beers while pub crawling. Big selection of beer and alcohol, so everyone should be able to find a drink they like. Pool table and juke box complete the vibe. I'll try their kitchen next go around.”

tip.text: Come late morning on a weekday. One reviewer walked in quiet around eleven and had the place to himself, which is when the shuffleboard is free and nobody is waiting on the pinball.

getting_here: 4801 Bienville Ave in Mid-City, on the corner a few blocks off Carrollton
Free street parking on the surrounding blocks, and the Canal Street streetcar runs a short walk away
cta_h2: Open at eleven. Shuffleboard's in the back.
